title: Québec Mega Trail — aid stations and menu
claims: The aid-station page lists nine stations open to QMT135: Halte de l'Arche, Massif, Cap Salut, Cap Gribane, St-Tite-des-Caps, Mestachibo, MSA, Summit and Fondeur.
Crew are flagged as allowed at Massif, St-Tite-des-Caps, MSA, Summit and Fondeur, and not flagged at Halte de l'Arche, Cap Salut, Cap Gribane or Mestachibo.

XACT products are served at all aid stations; the listed food includes salted potatoes, chips, hard-boiled eggs, fruit, soup, grilled cheese, pickles and maple syrup, with some items reserved for 135 km runners.
The page still lists QMT-110 among the distances at the Fondeur station, although the 110 km race was merged into the 135 km from 2025.
La Coulée is listed for QMT-25 only.
